verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own escalation paths that route alerts to schedules and team members, with rules based on priority and working hours. However, the evidence never describes multi-step escalation mechanics. Missing for 10: documented sequential escalation steps with delays/timeouts, fallback responders when a step goes unanswered, repeat rounds, acknowledgement-driven stopping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, escalation policies walk unacknowledged pages through multiple steps — delays, fallback responders, and repeat rounds — until someone acknowledges

citations.quote: Escalations: Route alerts to the appropriate escalation paths, schedules, and team members.
You can now set up rules around priority and/or working hours to ensure you page the right people at the right time without causing additional noise.
On-call routes alerts by team, service, or anything else that makes sense.
